title: Add alpha release bundle validator
summary: Release bundles can now be scaffolded, but there is no mechanical check that the bundle contains parseable evidence, validation notes, and a recorded decision. Add a small validator so alpha release evidence can fail closed before publication decisions.
expectedFailureModes: A bundle is missing evidence.json or validation.md but still treated as release evidence.
Evidence JSON is malformed or from the wrong schema kind.
A bundle with dirty evidence, pending gates, or no decision is accepted silently.
nextAction: Add a release bundle validator command, document it in the alpha release runbook, and verify help plus a generated self-test bundle.
